alice.tuprolog
Class Prolog

java.lang.Object
  |
  +--alice.tuprolog.Prolog
All Implemented Interfaces:
java.io.Serializable
public class Prolog
extends java.lang.Object
implements java.io.Serializable

The Prolog class represents a tuProlog engine providing basic services to solve goals, manage theories and libraries.
